eyebrow.zh: 本地 · 不出境 · 一条命令

headline.zh:
删除请求来了
先看清 PII 散落在哪
headline.en:
A deletion request landed.
See where the PII is scattered first

sub.zh: 给一个主体标识，30 秒内定位它在 agent 记忆图、向量索引、压缩轨迹里的全部 PII 残留——跨异构存储的反向索引，全程数据不出境。
sub.en: Hand it a subject ID; in 30 seconds locate every PII residue across your agent memory graph, vector index, and compressed traces — a reverse index across heterogeneous stores, fully on-prem.

title.zh: 一条命令，定位全部残留

body.zh: 给个手机号、身份证号或邮箱，扇出到 SQLite、向量索引、压缩轨迹三类存储，把某人的 PII 在 agent 记忆里的藏身处一次找全，写入 residue_map.json。
body.en: Give a phone, ID, or email; it fans out to SQLite, vector index, and compressed traces to find every place someone's PII hides in agent memory, writing residue_map.json.

body.zh: 单进程、本地存储、离线运行。定位方向不下载任何 embedding 模型——合规证明不建立在模型之上。
body.en: Single process, local stores, offline. The locate direction downloads no embedding model — compliance proof can't rest on a model.

title.zh: 补上 recall 到 delete 的反向索引

body.zh: 现有的记忆工具擅长 ingest 到 recall，没人拥有反向定位。清痕补这一段：从主体标识出发，跨异构存储找到全部 PII 残留——为个保法删除请求而生。
body.en: Today's memory tools own ingest→recall; nobody owns the reverse. SubjectPurge closes the gap: from a subject ID, locate every PII residue across heterogeneous stores — built for PIPL deletion requests.

headline.en: A deletion request shouldn't be a guessing game

sub.zh: 先定位全部残留，剩下的留给你的删除流程。本地、不出境、一条命令。
sub.en: Locate every residue first, then run your deletion process. On-prem, no cloud, one command.

tag.zh: 清痕 — per-subject 删除溯源器
